note: exercice partiel de l'option des acheteurs initiaux : principal total porté à 594,4 M$ (part de l'option non écrite ; 525 M$ relevés à la clôture du 11 décembre 2024) ; achats de bitcoins sans contrepartie nommée
quote: On December 16, 2024, the Company issued a press release announcing the closing of its previously announced offering of $594.4 million aggregate principal amount of the 2030 Notes, which included the partial exercise by the initial purchasers of their option to purchase additional 2030 Notes.
